items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: when he was playing with Billy Eckstine and shit. ... Yeah, in Eckstine's band.

ctx.x: Yeah, I guess he was, because I didn't hear no difference in what he was doing than from anybody else. Until when I got here to New York, and that was much later when I got to know him, when he was playing with Billy Eckstine and shit.
